visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a black cap and a dark green t-shirt is seated at a wooden table, smiling and gesturing with his hands while talking. Behind him is a traditional wooden lattice screen. To his right, a person in a blue cap is partially visible. (2) The camera cuts to a middle-aged woman in a purple t-shirt with a 'Thirty-Nine' logo, speaking expressively with hand motions. She sits in the same indoor setting with warm lighting. (3) A close-up shot reveals three small white square dishes containing peanuts, sesame seeds, and tea leaves on the table. A large ceramic mortar containing tea leaves and a wooden pestle are also present. (4) The woman in the blue cap begins grinding the tea leaves in the mortar using the large wooden pestle. The man and the woman in purple look on, continuing their conversation. (5) A series of close-ups show the interior of the mortar where the ingredients are being ground into a green paste. The woman in the blue cap works vigorously. (6) The video shifts to a fast-paced sequence where the woman in the blue cap grinds the tea at high speed, smiling. Large text overlays and colorful graphic stickers appear around her as she moves rhythmically.
